# Provenance

Raw captures of the original MajorMUD 1.11p under MBBSEmu: 12 scripted scenarios (entry, creation, room walk, fight, shop, status screens, death, log-off), each with `raw.bin` (telnet stripped, CP437 and ANSI intact), `plain.txt` and the `script.json` that produced it.

Copied by card C-001 from `jnfisher/mmud-exploration` at commit `d92c84af0cb93f4eeeb6b72562ccbbc59d6e2e14` (2026-10-17), byte for byte. Do not edit these files; a card that needs different data adds its own subdirectory.
